**ENG Drawing Viewer 2.2.1 for Windows — Preview.** The rebuilt Windows version of the free, offline workspace for engineering drawings: view folders of PDF drawings and images, mark them up with numbered review comments, use 32 offline PDF tools and export PowerPoint slides, on your own PC.

This is a **Preview**: it has been built and tested automatically on Windows Server 2022 and 2025, but not yet on everyday Windows 10/11 PCs. Please report anything that doesn't look or work right in [Issues](https://github.com/ca-works/eng-drw/issues).

**Mac users:** the current Mac version is [2.2.0](https://github.com/ca-works/eng-drawing-viewer/releases/tag/v2.2.0).

## Download

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `ENG-Drawing-Viewer-2.2.1-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` | **Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit.** Installs for your user account only (no administrator rights), with a Start menu shortcut and an uninstaller. |
| `ENG-Drawing-Viewer-2.2.1-Windows-x64-Portable.zip` | The same app with no installer: unzip it first, then open `ENG Drawing Viewer.exe`. |
| `eng-drawing-viewer-2.2.1-source.zip` | The complete source code of this version, with build instructions. |
| `ENG-Drawing-Viewer-2.2.1-Windows-x64.cdx.json` | Software bill of materials. |
| `THIRD_PARTY_SOURCES.txt` and the two `libiconv` archives | Where to get the unmodified source of the copyleft libraries inside the app. |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums of every file. |

**First launch:** the app isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may say it protected your PC. Click **More info**, check that it's ENG Drawing Viewer, then **Run anyway**.

**Check your download** in PowerShell: `Get-FileHash .\ENG-Drawing-Viewer-2.2.1-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` and compare with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## What's in it

- Everything from the Mac app: sharp viewing of PDFs and images, MARK with numbered callouts and linked comments, 32 offline PDF tools, PowerPoint export and queue → PDF.
- Make Searchable (OCR) works out of the box with seven languages.
- Spelling uses Windows' own spell checker, and words you add are remembered.
- Send slides straight into a presentation open in PowerPoint.
- iPhone HEIC photos open once Microsoft's free HEIF and HEVC extensions are installed.
- Windows 11 styling with title bars that follow your light or dark theme; keyboard shortcuts that work with every keyboard layout.
- Open drawings aren't locked, and opening a file while the app runs brings it to the existing window.
- Offline: no account, no telemetry, no network connections.

## Built and checked

- Built from the published source archive; two builds are byte-for-byte identical.
- On Windows Server 2022 and 2025: 137 tests pass; the packaged app runs with no Python installed and outbound traffic blocked, opens no network connections, and loads only its own DLLs and Windows' own; the installer installs and uninstalls cleanly.
